_note: Which RCPA SPIA reporting row confirms each threshold analyte's Australian unit: the LOINC code of the RCPA row for the SAME analyte in the SAME specimen, or null with the reason. scripts/threshold_units.py then checks, mechanically, that the RCPA row's unit equals the converted Australian unit; only then does the local unit take primacy. A row for another specimen never confirms (Australian fluid cell counts are reported in 10^6/L, blood counts in 10^9/L).

base deficit.why: the source does not name the blood specimen; RCPA base deficit rows for arterial (1922-4), venous (1924-0) and capillary (1923-2) blood all give mmol/L

pleural fluid cholesterol.why: the RCPA lists cholesterol for serum/plasma only (14647-2, mmol/L); no fluid row

placental growth factor.why: not in the RCPA SPIA reporting sets

faecal immunochemical test.why: the RCPA lists faecal occult blood as qualitative only (2335-8); no quantitative faecal haemoglobin row

synovial fluid white cell count.why: the RCPA lists white cell count for blood only (6690-2, 10^9/L); fluid counts are commonly reported in 10^6/L, so the blood row cannot confirm
